get.description: The CORE API search allows you to perform comprehensive searches across multiple entities, including works, outputs, data-providers, and journals.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query (use specific fields like doi, title, authors, etc.)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset from the result set where you want the result to start. Needed for pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum size of your search results. The result set may be smaller than the limit.

parameters.name: stats
parameters.description: If set to true the search results will include statistics related to the entity. This property has an impact on the response speed.

200.description: Contains the entities matching the search query.
